verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a support article title about backing up a BitLocker recovery key. That implies Windows ships a disk-encryption feature, BitLocker, but gives no detail on how it works. Nothing in the pack ties that encryption to the TPM, describes how to enable it, or corroborates it hands-on. Missing for 10: any evidence of TPM-backed key protection, documentation of enabling or configuring disk encryption, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
